MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Fill the blank with the word that means "am called": 你好!我____小明。 (1 mark)
   A. 是
   B. 去
   C. 叫
   D. 有

2. Which sentence means "And you?"? (1 mark)
   A. 我叫小明。
   B. 早上好!
   C. 再见!
   D. 你呢?

3. Which Kiswahili word is like Mandarin 妈妈 māma? (1 mark)
   A. shule
   B. dada
   C. mama
   D. kaka

4. What does 客厅里有电视 mean? (1 mark)
   A. The television is in the kitchen
   B. The living room is on the television
   C. I like television
   D. There is a television in the living room

5. Fill the blank: 椅子在桌子____。 (The chair is under the table.) (1 mark)
   A. 里
   B. 下
   C. 上
   D. 是

6. What does 下 (xià) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Where
   B. Bathroom
   C. To put
   D. Under

7. What does 六 (liù) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Eight
   B. Seven
   C. Six
   D. Ten

8. Read the pinyin: jīntiān xīngqīsān. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Friday, go to the mosque.
   B. On Sunday, go to church.
   C. On Saturday I rest at home.
   D. Today is Wednesday.

9. Which is a good active listening habit? (1 mark)
   A. Face the speaker and listen for key words
   B. Think about lunch
   C. Talk to your friend
   D. Look at the wall

10. In 我的生日是三月五号, on which date is the birthday? (1 mark)
   A. 3 May
   B. 5 May
   C. 5 March
   D. 3 March

11. What does 号 (hào) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To play
   B. Gift
   C. They
   D. Date (day of the month)

12. Which word is pronounced mǐfàn? (1 mark)
   A. 饼
   B. 香蕉
   C. 米饭
   D. 葡萄

13. Which word is pronounced xǐhuan? (1 mark)
   A. 吃
   B. 饼干
   C. 喜欢
   D. 苹果

14. What does 喝 (hē) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Milk
   B. To eat
   C. Drinks
   D. To drink

15. Which body part helps you hear? (1 mark)
   A. 鼻子 bízi
   B. 耳朵 ěrduo
   C. 眼睛 yǎnjing
   D. 手 shǒu

16. Which word is pronounced hóngshuǐ? (1 mark)
   A. 云
   B. 天气
   C. 太阳
   D. 洪水

17. What does 洪水 (hóngshuǐ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Very
   B. Flood
   C. Not
   D. Also

18. What is back-chaining? (1 mark)
   A. Reading only the first word
   B. Singing a song
   C. Writing backwards
   D. Building a long sentence from its end

19. Which word is pronounced huāyuán? (1 mark)
   A. 花园
   B. 窗户
   C. 电视
   D. 沙发

20. What does 东西放好 mean? (1 mark)
   A. Wash hands
   B. Come here
   C. Put things away well
   D. Sit down

21. Which word is pronounced fángjiān? (1 mark)
   A. 放
   B. 房间
   C. 椅子
   D. 右边

22. Which word is pronounced chànggē? (1 mark)
   A. 快乐
   B. 唱歌
   C. 祝
   D. 号

23. What does 月 (yuè) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To give (a gift)
   B. Candle
   C. To play
   D. Month

24. Read the pinyin: zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè! What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. Happy birthday to you!
   B. My birthday is on 5 March.
   C. My friend gives me a gift.
   D. When is your birthday?

25. What does 不 bù mean in 我不喜欢咖啡? (1 mark)
   A. Not
   B. Also
   C. And
   D. Very

26. What does 我用耳朵听 mean? (1 mark)
   A. I use my mouth to speak
   B. I use my hands to write
   C. I use my ears to hear
   D. I use my eyes to see

27. Which character means "big"? (1 mark)
   A. 太
   B. 人
   C. 大
   D. 天

28. What does 里 (lǐ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Door
   B. Inside
   C. Bathroom
   D. To put

29. Which sentence means "The bathroom is beside the garden."? (1 mark)
   A. 电视在哪儿?
   B. 浴室在花园旁边。
   C. 窗户在沙发上面。
   D. 门在左边。

30. What is the main idea of a text? (1 mark)
   A. What the whole text is about
   B. The title font
   C. The first letter
   D. The last word

31. Which stroke goes from left to right? (1 mark)
   A. 横 héng
   B. 点 diǎn
   C. 竖 shù
   D. 撇 piě

32. Which part is common to the characters 妈, 姐 and 妹? (1 mark)
   A. 未
   B. 女
   C. 且
   D. 马

33. What does 唱歌 (chànggē) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To sing
   B. We
   C. Date (day of the month)
   D. Candle

34. Why use recycled materials for a card? (1 mark)
   A. It reduces waste
   B. It is not allowed
   C. It is heavier
   D. It costs more

35. What does 香蕉 (xiāngjiāo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Biscuits
   B. Banana
   C. Water
   D. Drinks

36. What does 洗手 (xǐshǒu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Two (before a counting word)
   B. Tooth
   C. To wash hands
   D. Ear

37. What does 刮风 (guā fēng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. The wind blows
   B. Small
   C. Snow
   D. Not

38. Which Chinese word means "left side"? (1 mark)
   A. 门 mén
   B. 客厅 kètīng
   C. 左边 zuǒbian
   D. 东西 dōngxi

39. How many strokes do 左 and 右 each have? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 5
   C. 4
   D. 3

40. Which Chinese word means "below"? (1 mark)
   A. 下面 xiàmiàn
   B. 门 mén
   C. 桌子 zhuōzi
   D. 东西 dōngxi

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 肉, 用 and 摸. (3 marks)

42. Explain how to pause when reading: what does a comma mean and what does a full stop mean? (3 marks)

43. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "There are five people in my family." (3 marks)

44. Explain one similarity and one difference between naming the days in Kiswahili and Chinese. (4 marks)

45. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Tomorrow is Thursday." (3 marks)

46. Tell how to tell 大 dà from 太 tài by looking. (2 marks)

47. State three rules of stroke order and give an example of each. (3 marks)

48. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 月 and 太阳. (2 marks)

49. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Good morning!" (2 marks)

50. Describe where three things are in a house using 在. Write the Chinese and the meaning. (4 marks)

51. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 午饭 and 快乐. (2 marks)

52. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The window is above the sofa." (3 marks)

53. Explain why a healthy plate should have food from several groups and name two groups with their Chinese names. (4 marks)

54. Explain the job of the apostrophe in the word nǚ'ér. (2 marks)

55. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is the sun." (2 marks)

56. Name the days of the week from Monday to Wednesday in Chinese with pinyin. (3 marks)

57. Read and translate: 冰箱在厨房。 Then write the question that asks where the fridge is. (3 marks)

58. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 天气 and 星期六. (2 marks)

59. Write two foods from each group: fruit and meat, with pinyin. (3 marks)

60. Write a sentence asking when a friend's birthday is, and a sentence answering that your birthday is on 10 May. Include pinyin. (4 marks)

61. Why is a healthy plate made from several food groups? Give an example of a food from two groups. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — 叫
   我叫 introduces a name.

2. D — 你呢?
   你呢? (nǐ ne?) means "And you?".

3. C — mama
   Mama means mother in both languages.

4. D — There is a television in the living room
   里 is inside and 有 is there is.

5. B — 下
   下 means under.

6. D — Under
   下 (xià) means under.

7. C — Six
   六 (liù) means six.

8. D — Today is Wednesday.
   jīntiān xīngqīsān. is 今天星期三。, which means "Today is Wednesday.".

9. A — Face the speaker and listen for key words
   Active listeners give the speaker attention and catch the key words.

10. C — 5 March
   三月 is March and 五号 is the fifth.

11. D — Date (day of the month)
   号 (hào) means date (day of the month).

12. C — 米饭
   米饭 is pronounced mǐfàn and means cooked rice.

13. C — 喜欢
   喜欢 is pronounced xǐhuan and means to like.

14. D — To drink
   喝 (hē) means to drink.

15. B — 耳朵 ěrduo
   耳朵 are ears.

16. D — 洪水
   洪水 is pronounced hóngshuǐ and means flood.

17. B — Flood
   洪水 (hóngshuǐ) means flood.

18. D — Building a long sentence from its end
   You start with the last part and add one part at a time.

19. A — 花园
   花园 is pronounced huāyuán and means garden.

20. C — Put things away well
   东西 is things and 放好 is put away well.

21. B — 房间
   房间 is pronounced fángjiān and means room.

22. B — 唱歌
   唱歌 is pronounced chànggē and means to sing.

23. D — Month
   月 (yuè) means month.

24. A — Happy birthday to you!
   zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè! is 祝你生日快乐!, which means "Happy birthday to you!".

25. A — Not
   不 is not.

26. C — I use my ears to hear
   耳朵 is ears and 听 is hear.

27. C — 大
   大 dà is big.

28. B — Inside
   里 (lǐ) means inside.

29. B — 浴室在花园旁边。
   浴室在花园旁边。 (yùshì zài huāyuán pángbiān.) means "The bathroom is beside the garden.".

30. A — What the whole text is about
   Details support the main idea.

31. A — 横 héng
   横 is the horizontal stroke.

32. B — 女
   女 means woman or female.

33. A — To sing
   唱歌 (chànggē) means to sing.

34. A — It reduces waste
   Reusing materials means less rubbish.

35. B — Banana
   香蕉 (xiāngjiāo) means banana.

36. C — To wash hands
   洗手 (xǐshǒu) means to wash hands.

37. A — The wind blows
   刮风 (guā fēng) means the wind blows.

38. C — 左边 zuǒbian
   左边 (zuǒbian) means left side.

39. B — 5
   Both have five strokes.

40. A — 下面 xiàmiàn
   下面 (xiàmiàn) means below.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: 肉: ròu, meat. 用: yòng, to use. 摸: mō, to touch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: A comma is a short pause and a full stop is a longer pause, so you can breathe and the listener can follow.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for comma, 1 mark for full stop, 1 mark for the reason.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我家有五口人。 wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: Similarity: both use numbers to make day names. Difference: Chinese counts from Monday (星期一 is week one) but Kiswahili counts from Saturday (Jumatatu, Monday, has tatu, three).
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for the similarity and 2 marks for the difference with an example.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: 明天是星期四。 míngtiān shì xīngqīsì.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: 太 has an extra dot at the bottom right.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the dot and 1 mark for naming the two characters correctly.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: Top to bottom (三), left to right (好: 女 then 子), horizontal before vertical (十), 撇 before 捺 (人).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule with an example.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: 月: yuè, month. 太阳: tàiyáng, sun.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: 早上好! zǎoshang hǎo!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

50. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: 床在卧室 (the bed is in the bedroom); 冰箱在厨房 (the fridge is in the kitchen); 电视在客厅 (the television is in the living room).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence and 1 mark for the meanings.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: 午饭: wǔfàn, lunch. 快乐: kuàilè, happy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: 窗户在沙发上面。 chuānghu zài shāfā shàngmiàn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

53. (4 marks)
   Answer: Each group does a different job. Vegetables and fruit (蔬菜, 水果) give vitamins, rice (米饭) gives energy, and meat (肉) helps the body grow.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for saying groups do different jobs, 1 mark for each group named, 1 mark for the job.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: It shows where one syllable ends and the next begins, nǚ + ér.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each part of the explanation.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是太阳。 zhè shì tàiyáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: 星期一 xīngqīyī, 星期二 xīngqī'èr, 星期三 xīngqīsān.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each day.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: bīngxiāng zài chúfáng. The fridge is in the kitchen. Question: 冰箱在哪儿?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for pinyin, 1 mark for translation, 1 mark for the question.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: 天气: tiānqì, weather. 星期六: xīngqīliù, Saturday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

59. (3 marks)
   Answer: Fruit: 芒果 mángguǒ, 香蕉 xiāngjiāo. Meat: 牛肉 niúròu, 鸡肉 jīròu.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for fruit, 1 mark for meat, 1 mark for correct pinyin.

60. (4 marks)
   Answer: 你生日是几月几号? nǐ shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào? 我的生日是五月十号。 wǒ de shēngrì shì wǔ yuè shí hào.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

61. (3 marks)
   Answer: Each group helps the body in a different way. For example rice gives energy and spinach gives vitamins.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for saying groups do different jobs, 2 marks for examples.
